basis: illustrative assumption, no field data: a protective device whose failure is hidden until tested (MTBF 50 000 FH), the same on both fleets
illustrative assumption: the device may be failed and undetected at most 1 % of the time on average; the classical failure-finding interval is then about 2 x 0.01 / rate (Moubray 1997)
illustrative assumption: the risk-based interval holds the unavailability target with 90 % posterior probability
illustrative assumption in relative cost units: one engineering investigation that finds nothing
illustrative assumption in relative cost units: one month of a degraded component left uninvestigated (extra removals, delays)
illustrative assumption in relative cost units: the extra loss of postponing a needed investigation by one month, counted only when the rate is above target
